question: Can validation-selected unmatched-risk thresholds and full/half sizing improve the declared downside objective?
selection: Require positive score relative to no-trade and paired episode mean CI lower bound >0; maximize mean minus 5% tail loss. Ties prefer half sizing then lower maximum-risk threshold. If none qualify, select no-trade.
stopping_condition: One matched validation league, freeze selection, one new-seed test; no final-test retuning.
limitations: Model was selected earlier using validation classification metrics, so validation selection has optimism.
Risk scores refer to full proposals; half-size execution is not independently calibrated.
Do not infer guaranteed loss bounds from risk thresholds or bootstrap intervals.
